title: Me page always claims the visitor has no account or saved profile
preconditions: A member signs in and saves persona data, then opens /me.
expected: Account summary reflects the actual session and saved profile.
observed: Unconditional JSX says exploring without an account and no profile inferred or saved.
impact: Contradicts persisted choices and makes account/save state untrustworthy.
validation: Static read of page; no conditional session lookup in this page. Not runtime reproduced.
fix: Bind the page to /me and persona resource state; show guest, loading, error and member copy distinctly.
effort: 0.5–1.5 engineering days assuming existing resource hooks
acceptance_test: Guest sees guest copy; two signed-in identities see correct state; saved profile survives refresh; no data from previous identity.

confidence: high for incomplete cleanup; exposure not exploited
title: Clear guest data on sign-out leaves spatial items and preview media
preconditions: Guest wardrobe/outfits or saved preview media exists, then a development member signs out with Clear guest data enabled.
expected: The stated guest data scope is erased or the UI accurately limits its promise.
observed: clearGuest removes onboarding draft and migration keys only; spatial IndexedDB stores have separate names and no sign-out cleanup call.
impact: A subsequent browser user can retain access to guest items/notes and saved preview imagery despite the checked clearing option.
validation: Static call trace; no private media inspected or runtime reproduction.
fix: Centralize optional device-data cleanup across guest stores and linked copies, with retry/error reporting; distinguish guest-only from account-backed records.
dependencies: Inventory of closet/outfit/media/preferences stores and retention semantics
acceptance_test: Create synthetic guest item, outfit and preview; sign out with erase on; reopen and verify absent across tabs; erase off preserves intended data; interrupted cleanup reports failure.

security_severity: not a demonstrated vulnerability; strict mode fails closed
title: Production browser sign-in and reauthentication are not composed
preconditions: Consumer built in production/sandbox mode; user has no existing first-party session.
expected: Trusted IdP login/callback establishes secure first-party session and supports recovery/recent-auth.
observed: Connections only invokes /session/dev and hides it in production; mounted gateway creates only development sessions. OIDC middleware verifies API bearer tokens, while the browser proxy forwards only bm_session and the client expects /session.
impact: Adding issuer/client credentials cannot give a new real browser user a working account journey.
validation: Static route inventory and transport/auth trace; no external IdP was used.
fix: Implement reviewed provider authorization-code/PKCE callback and browser-session/recent-auth flow, environment-specific redirects, logout/revocation and recovery UX; keep API bearer support separate.
dependencies: Chosen authorized IdP project, redirect domains, session policy, provider configuration and account mapping
effort: 3–7 engineering days plus provider setup/review; assumes existing identity store
acceptance_test: Real sandbox IdP sign-in and recovery, secure cookie, callback-state/PKCE failure cases, expired/revoked session, CSRF and recent-auth controls, two-user separation and logout.
